title: End and Beginning
subtitle: Momonga is the last online member of his game as it is being shut down. He wakes to find himself still in the game, but in a new persona.

title: The Floor Guardians
subtitle: Momonga explores the new world he is in, and makes plans with his guardians over how to handle the situation.

title: Battle of Carne Village
subtitle: Momonga sees that Carne village is under siege by invading forces, and goes to rescue them.

title: Ruler of Death
subtitle: Momonga defeats the Sunlight Scripture that was invading Carne, and launches a campaign to take over the world as Ainz Ooal Gown.

title: Two Adventurers
subtitle: Ainz and his battle maid Narbeal take on aliases of Momon and Nabe, respectively, and join an adventurer's guild to learn more about the world.

title: Journey
subtitle: Momon and Nabe team up with a group of adventurers called the Swords of Darkness on an adventure.

title: Wise King of the Forest
subtitle: Momon encounters a fearsome beast known as the Wise King of the Forest - which he finds is a giant hamster.

title: Twin Swords of Slashing Death
subtitle: Momon and Nabe find that their friends were slain by a psychopath and sorcerer, and track the killers down.

title: The Dark Warrior
subtitle: Momon and Nabe decimate Clementine and Khaljit.

title: True Vampire
subtitle: Ainz's subordinate, the vampire Shalltear Bloodfallen, comes under an enemy's possession and Ainz must make a plan fast to rescue her.

title: Confusion and Understanding
subtitle: Momonga does damage control at the guild while he assesses the reason for Shalltear's revolt. Coming to the conclusion that she is under an incurable status effect, Momonga goes to the treasury to retrieve some of the powerful weapons of Nazarick.

title: The Bloody Valkyrie
subtitle: Though Shalltear's skill set puts Momonga at a complete disadvantage, he steps forward into battle. He gave various world items to his guardians to ensure the safety of Nazarick in his absence. Now, all that is left is a battle of life and death!

title: Player vs Non Player Character
subtitle: Momonga reminds Shalltear that he is the master of Nazarick and that his name carries the weight of all the supreme beings of Ains Ooal Gown. After the battle comes to a close, Momonga quickly takes action to strengthen the defenses of Nazarick.

title: The Dawn of Despair
subtitle: Everyone and Nazarick makes plans to deal with each other and sets them in motion.

title: Departure
subtitle: Cocytus attacks the land of the Lizardmen, expecting an easy takeover. However, the Lizardmen decide to unite their tribes against their invaders.

title: Lizard Men, Gathering
subtitle: The combined Lizardmen fight against Cocytus's forces.

title: Army of Death
subtitle: As the Lizardmen celebrate their success, Ainz makes plans for a new assault.

title: The Freezing God
subtitle: Ainz sets a challenge for the Lizardmen: if their champions survive a fight with his champion, the ice insect Cocytus, they will earn their freedom.

title: Those who pick up, Those who are picked up
subtitle: Sebastian comes across a young slave and rescues her.

title: Blue Roses
subtitle: The Blue Rose adventurer group makes plans to investigate and learn about Nazarick. Meanwhile, Ainz is worried about managing the Lizardmen and Sebas's possible betrayal.

title: A Boy's Feeling
subtitle: Sebas is attacked but successfully defends himself, and makes two new friends and apprentices.

title: Soaring Sparks of Fire
subtitle: Sebas, Brain and Climb attack a brothel controlled by the Eight Fingers cartel to rescue its ladies.

title: Disturbance Begins in the Royal Capital
subtitle: Ains calls on Sebas to answer for his actions, and to discuss what is to become of Tuare. Renner meets with the Blue Rose, then Marquis Raeven, to consult with them about her planned attacks against Eight Fingers.

title: Jaldabaoth
subtitle: As Sebas fights Six Arms, Demiurge attacks Re-Estize to hide the retaliation against Eight Fingers amidst a demonic incursion.

title: The Final Battle of the Disturbance
subtitle: The battle with Eight Fingers comes to a head as a new demonic threat unleashes hellfire in the capitol.

title: The Ultimate Trump Card
subtitle: The guardsmen and adventurers face a daunting array of demons until Momon arrives and takes charge. Brain once again comes face to face with Shalltear. While Evileye is occupied, Demiurge reveals his plan to Ains.

title: A Ruler's Melancholy
subtitle: With the events of Re-Estize Kingdom and the Lizard Men behind them, the loyal servants of Nazarick return to their daily routines. Ains, however, is worried about the work/life balance of his NPCs. They work day in and day out without rest.

title: Carne Village Once More
subtitle: As Nazarick decides on their next steps, the village of Carne focuses on rebuilding their homes. Enri and her goblin troop are busy protecting the villagers, training the vigilante troop, and manning the fields. All the while, unrest builds in the forest.

title: Enri's Upheaval and Hectic Days
subtitle: Enri meets Agu, who tells everyone that the Giant of the East and Demon Snake of the West are gathering forces to fight the master of the Monument of Ruin. Enri and the others take action, but little does she know how crazy the day will become.

title: Giant of the East, Demon Snake of the West
subtitle: Ains decides to go and see the Giant of the East and Demon Snake of the West himself. If they are similar to Hamusuke, they may have some worth as experimental subjects. They may also be useful in testing Lupisregina's capabilities with the village.

title: Two Leaders
subtitle: The "Giant of the East" has come to attack Carne Village, but the villagers are willing to put their lives on the line to protect their home and families. While the goblin troop defends the front gates, Enri and Nphirea defends the village from behind.

title: Invitation to Death
subtitle: The Tomb of Nazarick continues their plan for world domination and Ains visits the Baharuth Empire as Momon of Darkness. Meanwhile, Count Femel hires a large number of Workers to explore a certain tomb recently discovered in Re-Estize Kingdom.

title: Butterfly Entangled in a Spider's Web
subtitle: The foolish workers that have entered the Tomb of Nazarick greatly anger Ains Ooal Gown. Albedo and the others have already finished preparations for their welcome and Lord Ains watches on, determined that not a single one leaves his tomb alive.

title: A Handful of Hope
subtitle: The worker group Foresight is teleported to the fighting arena in the sixth floor to challenge the great Ains Ooal Gown. Ains tries to restrain his smoldering fury as he disposes the last of the filthy thieves that dare trample into his treasured Nazarick.

title: War of Words
subtitle: Ainz sends Aura and Mare to the Empire with a message. Come and apologize or watch as your country burn to the ground. With no other option, Emperor Jircniv heads toward Nazarick with the head of a noble in tow. Though, things are not as they seem.

title: Preparation for War
subtitle: Re-Estize Kingdom prepares for war after receiving a declaration from the Empire that they will claim the land near E-Rantel for the Sorcerer King Gown. Gazef knows the magic caster's strength, but he cannot stop what has already been set into motion.

title: Another Battle
subtitle: Carne Village is in a pinch once again. An army led by the first prince of Re-Estize has appeared, demanding to be let in so the villagers can be questioned about Ains Ooal Gown. Enri must make a decision for the village and its people.

title: Massacre
subtitle: The war is finally starting. The Empire plans to use this chance to see the depths of the Sorcerer King's power, whilst the Kingdom is confident that they have fully prepared themselves for this war. Gazef stands ready. Now, let the massacre begin.

title: Player vs Player
subtitle: Gazef challenges Ains to a duel that is impossible to win and Ains decides to accept. The battle will soon come to an end and the fate of E-Rantel will be decided. Even amongst the bloodshed, Gazef and Ains both hold the other in deep respect.

title: Sorcerous Nation of Ainz Ooal Gown
subtitle: Ainz acquaints himself with the day-to-day politics of the Sorcerer Kingdom, where he gained power just a while ago. As he feels overwhelmed by the responsibilities on his shoulder with an unclear vision of the future Ainz finds peace

title: Re-Estize Kingdom
subtitle: Princess Renner meets with the children of the orphanage that she has opened while Prince Zanac receives the diplomatic corps of the Nation of Darkness. Albedo is pleased with her welcome in the Re-Estize Kingdom.

title: The Baharuth Empire
subtitle: Cardinals have a meeting deep within the Slain Theocracy to discuss political problems which include the frightening rise of Momonga to power.

title: The Ruler of Conspiracy
subtitle: Momonga does everything in his power to fix a meeting with a promoter who can help him get a fight with the Warrior King at the Colosseum.

title: In Pursuit of the Land of Dwarves
subtitle: The show follows Momonga as he begins to plan his ambitious trip to the dwarven kingdom to establish mutually beneficial ties.

title: The Impending Crisis
subtitle: The Quangoas finally manage to make it to the Feo Jera and only a gate is left protecting the entire dwarven kingdom.

title: Frost Dragon Lord
subtitle: Before Aainz and his companions reach the ancient capital which is now used by the Frost Dragons' family and the Quangoas, the latter meets the former with the hope of finding protection.

title: An Unexpected Move
subtitle: Philip Montserrat devises a plan to turn the Sorcerer Kingdom against Re-Estize, hoping that it will give him some political advantage.

title: Countdown to Extinction
subtitle: Nazarik prepares to attack. the war is begin.

title: Last King
subtitle: Ains army marches towards the royal capital to finally annihilate the Re-Estize Kingdom. Various forces prepare themselves for the coming onslaught. Before the last battle, Zanac rides alone to meet with Ains for a peaceful discussion.

title: Well-prepared Traps
subtitle: Ains and Albedo use themselves as bait as they approach the royal capital. Azuth comes to defend the capital and quickly separates the two. While the two of them exchange blows in the air, a mysterious figure comes to visit Ains.

title: Invasion of the royal capital
subtitle: Everyone in the Re-Estize Kingdom makes their final preparations as the Sorcerer Kingdom's army invades the royal capital. Some try to escape and some just wait to die. But there are a few among them who wish to fight until the very end.

title: The Witch of the Falling Kingdom
subtitle: Ainz Ooal Gown's assault on the Re-Estize Kingdom's royal capital marked inexorably toward its final phase.
